verdict.rationale: Insomnia (part of Kong's ecosystem) supports exporting design documents for version control and importing/exporting OpenAPI/Postman collections, and Inso CLI enables git-workflow automation of collections/tests in CI, which supports storing/versioning collections as text files in a repo. However, this is via Insomnia's export/CLI workflow rather than a native git-backed plain-text file format for Kong Gateway itself, and decK's declarative config (YAML/JSON) for Kong Gateway isn't explicitly framed as 'collections' git-versioning in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit documentation of native plain-text file format kept in sync with git (not just export/import), first-party guidance on git workflow integration for collections specifically, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this git-versioning workflow.
